memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Now the third day was Pharaoh's birthday, and he gave a feast for all his officials. He lifted up the heads of the chief cupbearer and the chief baker in the presence of his officials: He restored the chief cupbearer to his position, so that he once again put the cup in Pharaoh's hand— but he impaled the chief baker, just as Joseph had said to them in his interpretation." - Gen 40:20-22 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Three days later, on Pharaoh's birthday, everything happens exactly as Joseph had foretold. The cupbearer is restored to his position, and the baker is executed — each dream fulfilled to the letter. Joseph's interpretations were not lucky guesses or wishful thinking; they were the true word of God, and God's word came to pass precisely as spoken.

This is a quiet confirmation of a great truth: when God speaks, it happens. His word does not fail or fall to the ground. What He says will be, will be. The cupbearer and baker discovered, in a matter of days, that the message Joseph delivered was utterly reliable — because it came from God.

We can rest our lives on this same certainty. God's promises in Scripture are not vague hopes or empty words; they are as sure as these interpretations that came true on the third day. "The word of our God endures forever" (Isa 40:8). Whatever God has said, He will do.

This gives us confidence in both the promises and the warnings of God. His promises of grace, forgiveness, and eternal life are certain for those who trust Him. And His warnings about sin and judgment are equally true and not to be ignored. Build your life on the reliable word of God, for what He has spoken will surely come to pass.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do I truly trust that God's word will come to pass?
2. Am I building my life on His reliable promises?
3. Do I take God's warnings as seriously as His promises?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that Your word never fails but comes to pass exactly as You have spoken. Help me to build my life on Your reliable promises, and to trust and heed all that You have said. Amen.
